# Logo

The official Infoquest lockup — top-left of cover/header bands, bottom-right of carousel covers and CTAs.

`InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.Logo` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.Logo />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="InfoquestDesignSystem_80b250.Logo"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The official Infoquest lockup: purple "iq" roundel + purple "info" + "quest" in black (color) or white (inverse).

## Props (LogoProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"color" \| "inverse" \| "white"` | color = light pages; white = aurora bands and photography (default, as in the source PDFs); inverse = solid black/near-black grounds only |
| `markOnly` | `boolean` | Just the purple "iq" roundel |
| `height` | `number` |  |
| `assetBase` | `string` | Path to this design system's assets/ folder, relative to the page. Default "assets/". |
